exercise.order: After backfire returns from explosion, damage/half-physical/losehp and whole-item retirement, dozap calls exercise(A_STR,FALSE) before ECMD_TIME. If fatal losehp terminates rather than returning, exercise is not reached; returning lifesaving paths require their own B1 evidence.
exercise.conditional_draw: For STR, if unpolymorphed and abs(AEXE(STR))<50, consume exactly rn2(2); AEXE_after = AEXE_before - roll (roll0 unchanged, roll1 minus1), using state at the exercise call. ACURR/base strength is not directly decremented by exercise.
exercise.no_draw: Polymorphed physical STR returns without draw/state change or exercise encumbrance callback. Unpolymorphed abs(AEXE(STR))>=50 skips draw/state change but still reaches encumber_msg if moves>0. No call/draw for uncursed, failed wrest, negative, non-backfire cursed or nonreturning fatal exits.
exercise.events: No unconditional STR exercise gameplay message is specified by pinned exercise; debugpline is not a gameplay log. For unpolymorphed STR, moves>0 invokes encumber_msg after the update/skip; its possible state-dependent event must be bounded by the HE02 seam. Never reuse current world.exercise_attr as-is: it emits You feel weaker! without AEXE/RNG changes.
